notes.title: Patch v.05
notes.content:
Small patch for the last update
New items:
Handmade Hatchet: a craftable hatchet in case the starting hatchet breaks, not really durable.

New structures:
Rudimentary anvil: a handcrafted rock anvil, easier to get at start in case metal is out of the game.

Added a UI element in the inventory and during the game to show a main quest to follow in order to help facilitate the story progression.

General Fixes:
The starting hunting hatchet model has been changed.
Fixed a bug in the anvil that would let the player click repair and start the bar progression when no weapon/armor was in slot.
I reworked the crafting panel UI to allow an easier experience in finding items and crafting them.
Fixed a part of the river that was non interactable.

notes.title: ARMOR AND WEAPONS UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

There is a lot of stuff that has been added to the game with this great update and I could not be more happy with it.
[p align="justify"]I have worked really hard since the last patch to fix as many bugs as possible and to expand the game, adding requested features, map extensions, items and new mechanics.
[p align="justify"]Thank you everybody for supporting the game and thank you to everyone who tested it, especially @McDonnell Douglas AH-64 Apache in my Discord who helped a lot.
[p align="justify"]This is everything added in the game:


[previewyoutube="8DAl6hFMnLU;full"][/previewyoutube]


ARMORS AND WEAPONS UPDATE.
[p align="justify"]Armors were finally added to the game as a main new feature.
[p align="justify"]Armors can be crafted from the build panel using leather, bones or metal scraps.
[p align="justify"]Armors are divided into chest pieces and head pieces.
[p align="justify"]Each piece has a protection value. When the player wears an armor in the inventory by equipping it in the correct slot the bar in the game panel is filled with the protection amount. Zombies and explosions hit the armor before damaging the player’s health.
[p align="justify"]When an armor durability value is at 0 it gets destroyed.
[p align="justify"]Armors can be repaired using the anvil. 


[p align="justify"]The anvil gives the possibility to the player to repair not just armor but also normal weapons, which now have durabilities.
[p align="justify"]Weapons durability goes down when you hit something or use the weapon in case of glock, ak and crossbow. 
The main story weapons which are found around the map are not destroyed when their durability is at 0, they are just not usable anymore, until they are repaired. Craftable or findable weapons like the handmade hammer or the hammer are destroyed when they reach 0.
[p align="justify"]Armors and weapons are now unstackable.


[p align="justify"]The three types of armor added are:
Leather armor
[p align="justify"]Bones armor
[p align="justify"]Metal armor

[p align="justify"]Added a new weapon, the nailed wood plank, crafted from the build panel with wood plank, nails box and fabric.


[p align="justify"]Added a new trap: Gas trap


[p align="justify"]ARROWS:
[p align="justify"]2 new types of arrows are coming to the game:
[p align="justify"]Burning arrow
[p align="justify"]Exploding arrow
[p align="justify"]When reloading with the crossbow, it will automatically load the first arrow found in the inventory. If the player reloads again, it will try to load another type of arrow (if it is in the inventory).
[p align="justify"]In the UI the player can see which type of arrow he’s about to shoot.


[p align="justify"]MINIMAP:
[p align="justify"]After months you can now finally check your surroundings with a minimap while exploring the island and its secrets! 
[p align="justify"]Open the map with M and check the Points of Interests, the infected zones and the terrain around you!


[p align="justify"]THE WASTELANDS:
[p align="justify"]A new zone has been added to the game, the wastelands!
[p align="justify"]After the first explosion, radiation seeped deep into the earth, only to surge back out through geysers, transforming the palm beaches and oasis in a blistering, arid zone.


[p align="justify"]In this new area there is a new type of tree: the mutated palm. The palm wood is too strong to be cut down but when the player hits the trees, he can shake them and make goop fruits fall from them!
[p align="justify"]The water was intoxicated and turned into this greenish color, also becoming unhealthy for humans.
[p align="justify"]New locations were also added in this zone.


[p align="justify"]ITEMS ADDED:
[p align="justify"]Goop fruit: obtained by hitting the palm trees, and the fruit will fall to the ground.
[p align="justify"]Cactus pulp: obtainable from cactuses in the desert.
[p align="justify"]Wax: obtainable from beehives findable on top of trees. To destroy a beehive, shoot it or hit it with a weapon. Another way is to chop down the tree, the beehive will automatically be destroyed and drop wax. 
[p align="justify"]Putrid paste: a strong glue made out of goop fruits and wax usable for repairing tools and weapons.
[p align="justify"]Charcoal: obtainable by cooking in a grill wood.
[p align="justify"]Bones: dropped by dead zombies after decomposing with skulls. They are usable to craft some things.
[p align="justify"]Leather: obtainable from dead horses and dead deer.
[p align="justify"]Electrical wire: used in some recipes, obtainable in chests.
[p align="justify"]Gun cleaning kit: obtainable in chests, used in repairing guns.
[p align="justify"]Cactus energy drink: a strong energy drink made with water and cactus pulp.
[p align="justify"]Improvised handsaw: a craftable handsaw usable as an alternative to the normal handsaw.

[p align="justify"]WILD LIFE:
[p align="justify"]Living animals have been finally added to the game, which gives the player the ability to hunt them, collecting leather and meat.
[p align="justify"]Animals will spawn only in determined zones and in few quantities.
[p align="justify"]The added animals are:
[p align="justify"]Deers
[p align="justify"]Horses

[p align="justify"]FLASHLIGHTS:
[p align="justify"]A flashlight slot has now been added in the inventory, with new types of flashlights and torches joining the game, both craftable and findable.
[p align="justify"]The new flashlights and torches added are:
Torch: crafted with stick, charcoal, fabric and wax, gives the player a lot of light with a big flame.
[p align="justify"]Bottle candle: crafted with an empty glass bottle and some wax, small light but lasts almost forever.


[p align="justify"]NEW STRUCTURES:
[p align="justify"]Some new structures were added:
[p align="justify"]Leather bed


[p align="justify"]NEW POINTS OF INTEREST:
[p align="justify"]Various locations have been added to the game, new house complexes, an entire road going through the map, a bridge, a couple of small shops, 3 warehouses and small POIs.



General Fixes:

I reworked the way tools are needed for building and crafting. Now multiple tools can be used to craft something, for example before this update crafting a rope would need a hunting hatchet, but it made sense that if you can build it with a hunting hatchet you should be able to use a fire axe too. So now the rope can be built with the hunting hutchet or the fire axe. Same thing for other recipes and buildings with all the tools.


[p align="justify"]After a lot of time and work I could finally put my hands on the extremely intricate and bad system I first made for the cooking and rework it to get rid of every bug (I hope). Now the player can cook multiple foods with different grills at the same time, there should not be any more bugs about food despawning or glitching in the display.


[p align="justify"]Fixed AK47 having a shadow.
[p align="justify"]Fixed AK47 name and description.
[p align="justify"]As often requested I modified some values in the day/night cycle. Now the day lasts for about 10 minutes while the night is slightly sped up to last about 5 minutes. This guarantees a better experience during the day and less frustration in night hours.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that would make the ak47 collectable multiple times without ever despawning.
[p align="justify"]The loot in chests now respawns every 7 days. This is done to make longer saves and gameplay possible without ever finishing resources.
[p align="justify"]Fixed some broken colliders of powerpoles around the map.
[p align="justify"]Added a starting dying npc at the crash site to help the player start the game.
[p align="justify"]Added an audio when refilling water containers.
[p align="justify"]Fixed land mines, bear traps and skullcrusher not working with zombies.
[p align="justify"]Now the player can quickly move an item from the inventory to an empty hotbar slot by clicking left shift while left clicking on the item and vice versa from the hotbar to the inventory.
[p align="justify"]Fixed the blood pool spawn when zombies die and slightly changed the scrapped zombies pool’s sizes.
[p align="justify"]Also added the outline effect to dead zombies when collecting fabric/metal scraps.
[p align="justify"]Now food and drink are automatically selected after consuming.
[p align="justify"]Fixed the zombie despawn process that would not despawn any scrapped zombies and heavily impact performances.
[p align="justify"]Now if the player sleeps at any time at night he will wake up in the morning. If he sleeps during the day he will sleep for 8 hours and then wake up.
[p align="justify"]Now in the cooking panel the name of the items is shown on top of each item when hovering them like in the building panel.
[p align="justify"]Changed the position of 1 of the 2 possible starting spawn points.
[p align="justify"]Modified some recipes with new items.
[p align="justify"]Reworked the main menu look.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that would let the player attack/shoot while drawing the weapon which would make it impossible to switch weapon/object in the hotbar.
[p align="justify"]Added audio to bear trap when activating.
[p align="justify"]Changed the effects of land mines explosions.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug when collecting a weapon in the hotbar.
[p align="justify"]Fixed the weather zone in the desert and added a new environmental audio.
[p align="justify"]The post processing setting is now automatically off at start.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug when crafting items with inventory full.
[p align="justify"]When the player opens the panel now the arms are hidden temporarily.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug when filling containers with full inventory.
[p align="justify"]Improved performances for higher fps.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that would destroy boxes when reloading guns with a full inventory.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug in the cooking panel that would let the player place an item in the middle of the screen without an actual slot.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug when collecting items from the ground directly in the hotbar.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that would destroy guns from player’s hands when reloading with only hotbar slots available for ammos.
[p align="justify"]Reworked some spawn values for consumables.
[p align="justify"]Drinking alcoholic beverages now makes the player more tired.



This update took me a lot of time and I am really happy with the state of the game right now, I hope you can enjoy it and love it as much as I do :)

Thanks



Alessandro Bettini

notes.title: Patch v.03
notes.content:
Small patch with some upgrades today!

AK47!
After a long time the AK47  was added back in the game!
Find the AK47 hidden somewhere in the world and shoot your way through hordes of zombies like you’ve never done!

Refillable Containers!
Empty containers can now be filled with water from rivers, lakes and ponds.
Fillable containers:
Empty bottle turns into a water bottle.
Empty glass bottle turns into a glass water bottle.
Empty jug turns into a water jug.

Added the new item Glass water bottle.

General Fixes:
Fixed some doors not opening in the city.
Fixed a flying abandoned camp in the forest near the desert.
Reduced some utils and weapons recipes build times.
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to hit zombies in the head with arrows.
Added UI sounds when inspecting and moving items in inventory, chests and cooking panels.
Modified some lighting and weather values for a more cohesive atmosphere.

As always thank you everybody for the support :)

notes.title: Patch v.02
notes.content:
Fixed some stuff, changed some recipes and added some structures and a new item :)

Changed the recipe of the tent by removing the 6 metal scraps necessary.
Now the chest panel and the cooking panel are closable while using them by reclicking E or the designed interact key.
Fixed a bug that would show the blood panel when exiting from underwater even if no damage was taken.
Fixed a bug that would let the player get fall damage underwater.
Now items can be dropped from the chest panel too.
Added a small help label in the chest panel explaining how to fast move items.

New structures and item:
Added 4 new structures and a new item:
Small metal fence: a small metal fence to protect your base
Small metal gate: a small metal gate
Tall torch: a tall torch to light your base
Lantern pole: a big pole with a lantern on top

Lightbulb item: a lightbulb craftable with batteries and glass pieces to craft torches and the lantern pole.

notes.title: Patch v.01
notes.content:
Small patch of some launch bugs, sorry about the wait :)

Fixed a bug that would make eating in the tutorial impossible.
Fixed a bug that would keep head bobbing active in the tutorial while reading the instructions.
Hopefully fixed a bug when refilling the water canteen that would make interacting with anything else impossible
Removed the highlighted outline from the boss door while it was opening.
Specified in the house walls description that they need floors.
Fixed a bug in the tutorial that would not let the player move items from a chest to the player hotbar directly.
Changed the spikes defence description.
Now in the tutorial the player can see the item's description in chests too.

notes.title: New structures and fixes!
notes.content:
In this couple days I worked on some bugs and some new structures which I added in the game. I feel like base building can become more important and effective and I am going in that direction.
Let me know what you think and thanks as always for playing the game!

New item:
Added a new item, the metal pipe, this item can be found and used to build structures, it cannot be used as a weapon because it’s too heavy to swing.
Metal pipes can be found in chests but also looted from rusted cars around the map. 

New structures:
Sticks fence: A new fence to surround and protect your base with only sticks and ropes! 
Crate: Added a new craftable chest to store items in your base, the crate, a simple and industrial container to keep everything organized.
Wood entrance: A new entrance to substitute the usual gate! Add a western touch to your base!
Metal fence: A new metal fence to surround and protect your base!
Stone table: A new table made out of stone to make your house more beautiful than ever.
Shelf: A new furniture to place your items.
Wooden chair: A small chair to add to your rooms.

General Fixes: 🛠️
When a craft is interrupted the number of crafts now goes back to 1.
Now the player can’t destroy a chest he crafted if it contains items.
Added a smoking sound when smoking a cigarette.
Added a sound for consuming healing items like autobiotics or the medikit.
Now the player can sneak behind zombies and they will not see him/hear him while walking. The player is now only seeable if directly saw and if he makes sounds (shooting, attacking, running).
Changed handmade hammer recipe, now the player needs a stick, a rock and a rope to craft it.
Fixed the utils section in the build panel scrolling down too much.
Cigarettes are now easier to find.
Fixed a bug that when crafting an item with a full inventory the needed items would be destroyed but the crafted item would not be spawned in the inventory, now if the inventory is full the crafted item is dropped in front of the player.
Removed and invisible wall in the map near the junkyard.
Added an animation to doors opening.
Added a new building (garage) in the farm in the woods.
Added a new POI, a camping site near the river.

notes.title: Cutscene and fixes
notes.content:
Hey everybody, with this patch I fixed some important stuff that you can read down here, I added a couple new spots on the map and most of all a starting "cutscene" with some starting lore. 
I feel I am making big progress in these last weeks, and that we are always getting nearer to leaving Early Access and releasing the full game!

General Fixes: 🛠️
Now when the player is reloading the clock or the crossbow he can’t open inventory, build panels, chests or grills.
Now when the player is eating he can’t take out the flashlight.
Fixed a bug that would make the player’s head keep bobbing while sleeping.
Added a sound when the player selects the flashlight.
Fixed the wood gate not working.
Fixed some bugs in the player inventory, when exiting the inventory with an item being dragged, the item would stop where it was and remain there forever, now the item is respawned in the inventory. Also, if the inventory is full and the player closes it with a dragged item, the item will be dropped in the ground.
Fixed a bug that wouldn’t save correctly if the third city gate was open.
Now the compass has only one needle.
Added a setting to set on/off the autosave and fixed settings UI.
Added a setting to set the time between autosaves.
Added a help label in the chest panel.

I tried adding to chests and collectables a small question mark rotating over them to make them more visible and let the player know if a prop/object is a collectable/lootable item. I am not sure if I like it and most of all if it makes sense to have it, but I noticed a lot of people skipping chests and other collectables because they didn’t notice them or they didn’t think they were lootable or collectable. Let me know if you like it.

Added a new POI, an old shipwreck with a small camp near it.
Added a new (particular) house in the lake city.

Starting cutscenes 🎥
Finally added a starting “cutscene” to the game explaining why the player is on the island and what his mission is.

notes.title: General Fixes
notes.content:
Hi everybody, these last few days I've worked mainly on some big bugs and UI, added some settings and polished some aspects of the game, here is everything fixed:

General Fixes:
Fixed and changed some fonts in the UI.
Fixed skull spike colliding with the player while being built.
Changed Molotov recipe, now no tool is needed to build it.
Changed tool needed in the recipe for the Skullcrusher from the screwdriver to the handmade hammer.
Fixed a bug that would let the player modify the number of crafts while crafting.
Fixed a bug on player movement, player’s stamina would go down when shift was clicked even if the player was not moving, now it doesn’t.
Fixed running audio playing when clicking shift but staying still.
Now in the building panel the number of crafts automatically reset to zero after crafting more than one item.
Fixed a bug that made impossible drinking water from rivers or wells while having a consumable item in hand.
Fixed a well in a farm house from which you couldn’t drink.
Added the key binding settings for hotbar fast select 1, 2, 3 and 4.
Fixed some tutorial bugs.
Updated settings and pause panel UI, new background, changed fonts.
Fixed torch object which could not be destroyed, now it can.
The player can now start building a structure while walking/running.
Now all interactables/destroyable structures have a white outline when pointed at.
Added an autosave to the game every 30 minutes.

See you all with the next update:)

notes.title: New type of zombie and crafting mechanic
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is everything that is coming out with today's small update.
I started working on the building system for houses (roofs, walls, windows, floors ecc...) and it should come in the next update probably next week. Thank you!

New enemy! 🧟
A new type of zombie got added with this update, meet the scrapped zombie! This zombie mutated differently from the normal ones due to where he lived, he’s made of a weird lime substance similar to blood and from metal scraps!
Killing him will be harder, and he only walks around the desert… 
When killing these zombies the player can loot one piece of metal scrap from their dead bodies, making it easier to be found and used in craftings.

Destroyable structures ⚒️ 
Now structures can be destroyed by keeping C pressed while pointing at them for a bit. When a structure is destroyed the materials used to build it will be dropped in the ground.

General Fixes:
Fixed some colliders in props.
Campfires now create a small light when cooking.
Changed the font in the main UI buttons.
Added an help label in the inventory.
Fixed the furnace colliding with the player while being built.
Added small movement to the player’s hand while eating.

notes.title: Tutorial bugs fix
notes.content:
Fixed a lot of bugs in the tutorial including:
Impossible to pick up the starting hatchet
Could not drop items
Could not eat consumables

notes.title: quick bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a tutorial bug that wouldn’t let the player move.
Fixed arrow colliders.
Fixed some doors colliders in the city.

notes.title: QOL small update
notes.content:
Consumables finally as objects!

When the player selects a consumable object from the hotbar, no more empty hands moving! The food/drink is now in the player's hand!

Drop items!

Now from the inventory the player can drop an item or the entirety of the stack. The item will be dropped in front of the player and he can retake it at any time. After a while the dropped items will be destroyed.

General Fixes:

Fixed the way of showing items in the inventory.

notes.title: Small Patch, new items and recipes
notes.content:
General Fixes:
Now when the player sleeps, the running/walking sound is stopped.

Removed items:
Red wine
Rum
Candy Bar

New items:
Water Jug (drinkable)
Empty jug (from drinking water in the water jug)
Pot (for some crafting)
Alcohol bottle (substitute for red wine)
Metal sheet (worked metal scrap)
Feather (for crafting)

Changed some recipes in the building panel.

Added 2 new structures, the furnace and the campfire with pot, both for cooking.
I thought having more structures that do the same thing could be cool to have more styles and make a base more unique.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content: Fixed a bug from last update, compass would not show.

notes.title: Zombies and general fixes patch
notes.content:
Hi everybody, with today's update I made some important fixes of bugs that were in the game since the start and some important additions.
I worked on the zombies and I am slowly getting to have them be a bit better, update after update.
I strongly agree to make a new saving because with old ones there could be a problem with the chests loot.

Zombie movement and combat update 🧟:
Zombies have been reworked for better hitboxes and hits.
Now the player can hit from a little more distant, successfully hitting the zombies.
This new method for tracking hit and hitboxes is being tested with this update so it is not perfect nor definitive, but I consider it a good progress from the previous bugged hitboxes.
Now zombies should not spawn on roofs again.
Zombies now rotate before hitting a player in order to look at him (still to be perfectioned).

Important Fixes 🛠️:
Fixed a bug that was there since first release of the player slowly slipping away when staying still on terrain or on objects, now it stays still correctly and doesn’t slip away anymore.
Now the build panel allows you to craft more items with just one click, set the number of items you want to craft and once you click build all you’ll have to do is wait for the building to end!
Added a setting to set on/off the head bobbing.

General Fixes 🛠️:
Changed crossbow reload time from 1 second to 2.5 seconds.
Now players can drink and refill their canteen from wells around the map.
Fixed colliders on containers in the junkyard.
Reduced the amount of life the sterilized bandage heals.
Changed the compass name and description.
Changed the pack of cigarettes item into a single cigarette item.
Added a sound to the crossbow when shooting an arrow.
Fixed arrow collider for recollecting it after shooting.
Fixed a bug that would show a white box instead of the item picture when opening inventory.
Now arrows can be recollected from dead zombies killed with them too.
Changed arrow recipe to 1 stick and 1 metal scrap instead of 2.
Added a new POI in the woods, a small farm.

Thank you, hope you'll enjoy this update, see you at the next one in a few days.

notes.title: Small Fixes and new Weapon
notes.content:
Hi everybody, this is everything new with this small update.

New Weapon added: The Crossbow 🏹
Find the crossbow hidden in the junkyard and grab it for your defense.
No more risking your life to hit zombies with melees, shoot them safely from a far distance with your arrows!

New items: 
Arrows: With the crossbow obviously comes arrows! Find arrows in abandoned houses and chests and use them with your crossbow. If you don’t find them, craft them in the build panel!
Bottle of disinfectant.
Sterilized bandages: use them to heal yourself.

General Fixes:

 Added outline to sleeping bag collectables.
 Upgraded zombie spawn. Now when the player clears an area, it will not fill with zombies again for a while.
 Added a new POI near the river with a church and a small house.
 Added the setting for rebinding the pick up key.
 Added advice labels in the loading panel.
 Fixed collider of the sleeping bag while building colliding with the player.

notes.title: Important bug Fixes and new Object
notes.content:
Hey everyone, with today's update there are some main fixes to mechanics and UIs and a new palceable object.

New structure and object added, the Sleeping bag!
Find the sleeping bag around the world and place it wherever you want to sleep at any moment!
Then pick it up and bring it with you on your exploration!

General Fixes:
Lowered fatigue multiplier, now fatigue goes down slower.
Fixed door animation not working in certain doors.
Fixed the starting spawn in the inventory of the water canteen, the compass and the flashlight.
Fixed sleep multiplier.
Fixed volume settings not loading correctly in the main menu.
Fixed empty canteen not refilling when trying to refill in rivers/lakes.
Added walking and running sound for when the player is on roads and in buildings.
Players can now switch items in the hotbar using the mouse wheel.
Fixed bugged spawn of rocks and dead animals.
Fixed bug on zombie spawning.
Modified zombie spawns values for better realism, still working on this to perfection.
Added a UI element that shows the name of the items needed for a recipe in the building panel.
Changed inventory base key to TAB.
Fixed key bindings settings not getting saved correctly.
The game now runs in the background.

Thanks.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Small patch I worked on this morning, I just wanted to get this out.

Added new details to terrain like flowers.
Added a highlighted outline to interactable objects when looking at them.
Added blood pools spawning in the ground when killing zombies.

notes.title: Fixes and Map Updates
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is all that was added/fixed with today's update:

Map Changes
Added a new POI: The labs. The labs are on the top of a hill in the north of the island, where they used to study the radiation of the island working together with Zombarus Labs in the city. The labs remained active after the first explosion until the zombies invaded them and killed everyone.
Added a ship wrecked on the north beach of the island.
Changed the roads and added new trails in the map.

General Fixes
Added a new key to open the third gate of the city.
Added a quick save button.
Added player running and walking sounds.
Music now stops when loading a game.
Fixed a bug that wouldn’t let the player drink from rivers/lakes when not holding an object in the hotbar.
Added sounds to doors opening and closing.
Simplified some colliders for improved physics performances.
Added more particles when hitting trees with axes or hatchets.
Added a sound when hitting bushes with hatchets or axes.
Added UI sounds for mouse hovering over buttons and clicking them.
Lowered the sleepness value.
Fixed a bug that would sometimes make zombies spawns at the player position or extremely near him.
Fixed wrong hit audio playing when hitting bushes.
Randomized zombie wandering pause times and setted them to be longer than before.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi everyone, some fixes for the last update:

Fixed a bug when cutting trees in the tutorial and a bugged chest.
Fixed in the tutorial a bug that would close the panels when closing the tutorial explanation.
Modified some weapons collider for better hitboxes.

notes.title: General Fixes
notes.content:
New Structure:
The Gate!
Build a gate in your base to avoid zombies wandering inside of it and disturb you. With the gate you are gonna be safe inside your walls forever!

General Fixes:
Placing structures no longer modify the terrain texture but only removes details (grass).

notes.title: General Fixes and New Structure!
notes.content:
The planter! 
With the planter you can now grow tomatoes, beans and mushrooms in your own base without having to go looking around for them! Create a sustainable and safe way of finding food by planting your own! No more looting houses hoping to find something!

General Fixes:
Changed the way of consuming items, now players have to select it in the hotbar and left click to consume.
Fixed tutorial bugs and updated it.
Fixed missing audios in the tutorial.
Updated controls panel.
Fixed loading panel when reloading old games after dying.
Players can now get damage from fire and stop it by going underwater.
Fixed a bug that would not make the north door of the city open.
Fixed audio bug in the opening north door cutscene.
Fixed trees in the burnt zone.
Changed Spike wall image in the build panel.
Changed max slope for Spike wall from 10 to 15.

Map Changes:
Added an old survivor camp just outside the city.

notes.title: General Fixes
notes.content:
General Fixes:


 Fixed some audio problems (delays, audios not playing)
 Players can now sleep in hospital beds.
 Lowered land mines hit radius.
 Added new hit sounds when hitting an object with every weapon.
 Added a swimming sound.
 Fixed baseball bat and nailed baseball bat colliders.

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.content:
Added new types of structures: Traps!

Protect your base with land mines and heavy land mines, you will not have to worry about zombies anymore!
Craft them from the build panel, under the weapons category, and place them wherever you want!
But watch your steps, because they are not only for zombies! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268699/4b0ebd4ebd0c5bd3c2736fb23ae01d36178129c1.png

In a land with no bears, bear traps still find a use! Place them near your base and trap the first zombie that walks on it! Immobilize him and kill him easily with no risks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268699/4d58c4463b74cecdc7c628347319ee587c5f0a9e.png

No more worries about zombies wandering around your house, the skull crusher will take care of that! Wait for a zombie to walk under it and let the skullcrusher do what its name says!
This powerful trap is perfect for luring zombies and killing them without having to fight and risk your life!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268699/0ed13f592f26f8a7a8d4c05fade9b0f70164e40b.png

New items:
The skull! The skull is a new item spawned from the decomposed zombies. After dying zombies will start decomposing and at the end of the process a collectable skull will spawn at their place. The skull is used in crafting structures like the brand new Skull Spike and new uses will be added with future updates (traps and weapons).

General Fixes:
Fixed zombie saving file problem, now zombies are saved correctly in positions and numbers.
Fixed some weapons colliders and shadows.
Changed recipe of the spikes defences reducing the necessary logs from 10 to 5.
The yarn item was removed to be switched with the new rope item, simply for more sensed craftings and items.

notes.title: April Fool's Update
notes.content:
Zombie and Combat mini-update

First of all sorry everyone for the time that has passed from the last update, I have been away and couldn't work on the game for about a week.
Anyway this is all this update adds to the game:

Flashlight is now kept on the left hand, allowing the player to use it while also using one handed weapons or compasses. Flashlight is no longer equipped from the hotbar but from clicking F while having it in inventory.
Added a small light to the compass to make it visible at night.
Added combos to weapons, players can now make a 2 attacks combo with every weapon.
Updated main menu UI.
Upgraded both zombies and player attacks. Zombies can now hit the player more easily than before and they will stop the attack they were charging if hit. 
Upgraded also the zombie movement in the map and their wandering.
Updated controls UI in settings.
Zombies now avoid structures built by the player like walls and furniture, finally.

General Fixes:
Fixed shadows of some weapons/objects.
Fixed UI bug when loading/deleting old games from main menu.
When refilling the canteen with water it will disappear from the hand leaving empty hands.
Fixed a bug in the tutorial where trees would never fall.
Added missing errors in tutorial.
Fixed arms bug in tutorial and fast build panel bug.
Added missing audios in the tutorial.
After recharging the flashlight it now turns on automatically.

notes.title: Lighting and Weather Update!
notes.content:
A brand new lighting, weather system and day/night cycle is coming in Apocalypse Island with this huge update!


[previewyoutube=3tw7Y5S4ewk;full][/previewyoutube]

Implemented Enviro3 in the game to make all the next features:
New day/night cycle,
New weather system with 6 different possible weather types: sunny, 3 shades of cloudy, rain and storms (with lightnings!),
New lighting approach to the entire scene,
New environmental audios.

Added a new structure called the covered campfire, allowing players to use campfires even with rain or storm.

Normal campfires can now not be used when there is rain or storm.

Added a new starting object, the flashlight! 🔦
